name: align_center
description: Move an object so its center sits on the origin. 'reference' picks the bounding-box center or the center of mass. 'z' = 'center' centers on Z too, 'floor' puts the bottom on Z=0 (print-bed style), 'keep' leaves Z alone.

name: align_lay_on_face
description: Rotate an object so the given face points straight down (-Z), then drop it so its lowest point sits on Z=0, like a slicer's 'lay on face'. Accepts a Part face ('Face3', or 'Pad.Face3' under a Body) or a mesh facet ('Facet123'); for meshes the flat region around the facet is used.

angle_tolerance.description: Mesh only: degrees for growing the flat region

name: assembly_add_part
description: Add a part (any solid object) as a child to an assembly. Best-effort: actually adds via the assembly's group property.

name: assembly_create
description: Create a new Assembly container in the active document.

name: bool_common
description: Boolean intersection of two or more objects.

name: bool_cut
description: Boolean cut: subtract second object from first. Use bool_cut_many for chains.

name: bool_fuse
description: Boolean union (fuse) of two or more objects. Returns the new feature.

name: console_clear
description: Clear the captured console buffer.

name: console_print
description: Print a message to the FreeCAD console.

name: console_tail
description: Return the most recent FreeCAD console messages (log/message/warning/error).

name: direct_chamfer
description: Bevel edges of a solid with the given size (direct edit).

name: direct_fillet
description: Round edges of a solid with the given radius (direct edit).

name: direct_push_pull
description: Push or pull faces of a solid along their normals (Plasticity-style direct edit). distance > 0 adds material, < 0 removes it. Curved faces work too: pushing a hole wall out by 1 grows the hole radius by 1.

name: display_refine
description: Switch the 3D view to a refined, Plasticity-like look: MSAA anti-aliasing, finer tessellation of curved faces, thin crisp dark edges, softer satin shading with a key and fill light, a dark gradient background and smooth-shaded meshes. Updates open objects too. Previous settings are backed up for display_restore. Anti-aliasing applies to 3D views opened afterwards.

effects.description: Plasticity-style matcap shading, silhouette outlines and hidden seams

name: display_restore
description: Undo display_refine: remove the viewport effects and restore every display preference it changed.

name: doc_close
description: Close a document. Pass save=True to save before closing.

name: doc_get_properties
description: Get document-level properties (Label, Comment, Company, etc.).

name: doc_list
description: List all open FreeCAD documents.

name: doc_new
description: Create a new empty FreeCAD document and make it active.

name: doc_open
description: Open a FreeCAD document file (.FCStd or any supported import format).

name: doc_recompute
description: Force recompute of the named (or active) document.

name: doc_redo
description: Redo the previously undone operation in the active document.

name: doc_save
description: Save the named (or active) document. Use doc_save_as for a new path.

name: doc_save_as
description: Save the named (or active) document to the given path.

name: doc_set_active
description: Make a named document the active document.

name: doc_undo
description: Undo the last operation in the active document.

name: draft_circle
description: Draft: create a circle.

name: draft_line
description: Draft: create a 2-point line.

name: draft_text
description: Draft: create a text annotation.

name: draft_wire
description: Draft: create a polyline / wire from a list of points.

name: freecad_python_eval
description: Evaluate a Python expression in FreeCAD and return its value. For multi-statement code use freecad_python_exec instead.

name: freecad_python_exec
description: Execute arbitrary Python code inside FreeCAD's interpreter. Variables persist between calls. Pre-imported: App (FreeCAD), Gui (FreeCADGui), Part, Draft, Sketcher, PartDesign. Returns captured stdout/stderr.

name: gui_command_info
description: Return the menu text, tooltip, and pixmap of a GUI command.

name: gui_list_commands
description: List every registered FreeCAD GUI command name. Each name can be passed to gui_run_command. Optionally filter by substring.

with_info.description: Include menu text + tooltip for each command

name: gui_run_command
description: Run a FreeCAD GUI command by name (e.g. 'Std_New', 'Part_Box', 'PartDesign_Pad'). Equivalent to clicking the menu/toolbar item. Use gui_list_commands to discover available names.

name: io_export
description: Export objects to a CAD file. Format detected from extension (.step, .iges, .brep, .stl, .obj, .dxf, .svg, ...).

objects.description: Object names; if empty, export all visible Part shapes

name: io_import
description: Import a CAD file (.step/.iges/.brep/.stl/.obj/.dxf/.svg/...) into a FreeCAD document. Auto-detects format from extension. Creates a document if none exists.

name: measure_bounding_box
description: Get the axis-aligned bounding box of an object's shape.

name: measure_distance
description: Measure shortest distance between two sub-elements. Each ref is 'ObjectName' or 'ObjectName.Face1' / '.Edge2' / '.Vertex3'.

name: measure_mass_properties
description: Volume, surface area and centre-of-mass of an object's shape.

name: mesh_export
description: Export selected (or named) objects to a mesh file (.stl/.obj/...).

objects.description: If empty, export all visible Part shapes

name: mesh_import
description: Import a mesh file (.stl/.obj/.ply/...) into the active document.

name: mesh_import_file
description: Import a mesh file (.ply/.stl/.obj/...) into the active document and return the imported object's name(s). Equivalent to File -> Import in the GUI.

name: mesh_loft_solid
description: Reverse-engineer a mesh into a boolean-able solid by slicing the mesh perpendicular to a chosen axis, extracting the outer silhouette at each slice, fitting B-splines, and lofting. Use this when the built-in 'shape from mesh' produces a non-manifold solid that fails boolean operations. All inputs are validated and resampled to safe sizes so OCC's loft algorithm cannot hang.

mesh_object.description: Name of the Mesh::Feature object to convert

n_slices.description: Number of cross-sections to extract (ignored if resolution_mm is set)

resolution_mm.description: Spacing between cross-sections in mm. If given, overrides n_slices.

points_per_slice.description: Points to resample each slice to before lofting

margin.description: Skip this many mm from each tip of the mesh's axis range (degenerate slices)

result_label.description: Name for the resulting solid object

keep_intermediate.description: Keep the intermediate B-spline wires in the document for inspection

hide_mesh_after.description: Hide the source mesh after the solid is built

loft_max_degree.description: Maximum B-spline degree for the loft surface. Lower = less overshoot, more facetted.

loft_ruled.description: If true, build flat ruled panels between consecutive wires (no smoothing).

name: mesh_rebuild_cad
description: Rebuild a scanned mesh (or a faceted solid converted from one) as a clean CAD solid with minimal faces, as if modelled from scratch. Best for 2.5D parts (plates, brackets, housings): finds the main axis and height levels, fits each layer's outline with lines, arcs and circles, squares near-axis edges, equalises matching dimensions, averages mirrored features when the part is symmetric, rounds sizes to `grid`, then extrudes and fuses.

grid.description: Round dimensions to this step (mm); 0 = off

snap_angle.description: Snap edge angles to multiples of this (deg)

placement.description: overlay = on top of the scan; origin = axis-aligned at the origin

name: mesh_to_shape
description: Convert a Mesh::Feature into a Part (CAD) object. Facets are sewn into a shell, promoted to a solid when closed, and coplanar facets are merged (refine). Exact faceted conversion - for smooth B-spline approximations of organic meshes use mesh_loft_solid instead.

refine.description: Merge coplanar facets into single faces

repair.description: Fix duplicates, degenerate facets and normals first

decimate_to.description: Optionally reduce the mesh to about this many facets first

name: mesh_to_solid_multi_axis
description: Reverse-engineer a mesh into a boolean-able solid using one or more slicing axes. With a single axis, produces the same result as mesh_loft_solid. With two or three axes, builds a per-axis loft and INTERSECTS them (Boolean common) — concavities that would be lost in any single direction's convex-hull silhouette are caught by another axis. Resolution is the spacing between slices in mm.

mesh_object.description: Name of the Mesh::Feature to convert

axes.description: Slicing axes. Multiple axes are intersected.

resolution_mm.description: Distance between consecutive cross-sections in mm

loft_ruled.description: Ruled loft (faceted, robust). Set false for smooth (may overshoot).

keep_per_axis_lofts.description: If true, keep the per-axis loft solids in the document for inspection

name: obj_delete
description: Delete an object from its document.

name: obj_get
description: Get all properties of an object by name.

name: obj_list
description: List all objects in a document. Returns Name, Label, TypeId for each.

name: obj_rename
description: Change an object's user-visible Label.

name: obj_set_property
description: Set a property on an object. Value should be a JSON-compatible value. Vectors can be passed as {x,y,z}; placements as {Base:{x,y,z}, Rotation:{Axis:{x,y,z}, Angle: rad}}.

name: obj_set_visibility
description: Show or hide an object in the 3D view.

name: obj_shape_info
description: Inspect the geometric shape of an object: bounding box, volume, area, vertex/edge/face counts. Only meaningful for Part-based objects.

name: part_box
description: Create a Part::Box primitive.

name: part_compound
description: Combine objects into a Part::Compound (no boolean op, just grouping).

name: part_cone
description: Create a Part::Cone primitive.

name: part_create
description: Generic Part primitive creator. Pass a TypeId (e.g. 'Part::Wedge', 'Part::Ellipsoid', 'Part::Prism') and a dict of properties to set.

name: part_cylinder
description: Create a Part::Cylinder primitive.

name: part_plane
description: Create a Part::Plane primitive.

name: part_sphere
description: Create a Part::Sphere primitive.

name: part_torus
description: Create a Part::Torus primitive.

name: pd_active_body
description: Return the currently active PartDesign Body, or null.

name: pd_chamfer
description: Chamfer edges of a body.

name: pd_create_body
description: Create a new PartDesign Body. The Body becomes the active body.

name: pd_create_sketch
description: Create a Sketcher::SketchObject on a plane. plane can be 'XY','XZ','YZ', the name of a planar face like 'Body.Face1', or another existing reference.

name: pd_fillet
description: Add a fillet (rounded edge) to a body. edges should be a list like ['Edge1','Edge3'] of the previous feature.

name: pd_pad
description: Pad (extrude) a sketch into a solid in the active or named body.

name: pd_pocket
description: Cut a pocket in the active body using a sketch.

name: pd_revolution
description: Revolve a sketch around an axis to make a solid.

name: pref_get
description: Get a preference value. group is a path like 'User parameter:BaseApp/Preferences/View'. type must be one of: bool, int, uint, float, string.

name: pref_list
description: List preference subgroups under a group.

name: pref_set
description: Set a preference value (see pref_get for group/type meaning).

name: selection_add
description: Add an object (and optionally a sub-element like 'Face1') to the selection.

name: selection_clear
description: Clear the current 3D-view selection.

name: selection_get
description: Get the current 3D-view selection (objects + sub-elements).

name: selection_remove
description: Remove an object from the selection.

name: server_ping
description: Liveness check that does NOT touch FreeCAD state. Survives even when the main thread is locked in a long OCC operation.

name: shape_to_mesh
description: Convert a Part shape into a Mesh::Feature using the standard mesher.

name: sketch_add_arc
description: Add an arc by center, radius, start angle (deg), end angle (deg).

name: sketch_add_circle
description: Add a circle to a sketch (centered at cx,cy with radius r).

name: sketch_add_constraint
description: Add a constraint to a sketch. type: Horizontal/Vertical/Coincident/Parallel/Perpendicular/Tangent/Equal/Symmetric/Distance/DistanceX/DistanceY/Radius/Diameter/Angle. args: list of (geom_index, point_pos) pairs OR plain integers depending on the constraint. value: numeric value for dimensional constraints (in mm or rad as appropriate).

name: sketch_add_line
description: Add a line segment to a sketch. Coordinates are in the sketch plane (X,Y).

name: sketch_add_rectangle
description: Add a rectangle as 4 connected line segments. Returns the 4 geometry indices.

name: sketch_delete_geometry
description: Delete geometry elements by index from a sketch.

name: sketch_get_geometry
description: List all geometry elements in a sketch.

name: ss_create
description: Create a new Spreadsheet.

name: ss_get
description: Get a cell's contents (raw expression) and computed value.

name: ss_set
description: Set a cell value (e.g. cell='A1', value='=2*3' or 42 or 'hello').

name: ss_set_alias
description: Assign an alias to a cell so it can be referenced by name in expressions.

name: transform_copy
description: Make a Part::Copy of an object (independent copy of the shape).

name: transform_mirror
description: Create a Part::Mirroring of an object across a plane (defined by base+normal).

name: transform_rotate
description: Rotate an object around an axis through a center point by an angle (degrees).

name: transform_set_placement
description: Set an object's absolute placement.

name: transform_translate
description: Translate an object by (dx, dy, dz). Modifies its Placement.

name: tree_expand
description: Expand or collapse a node in the model tree.

name: tree_get
description: Return the document's object hierarchy (as shown in the tree view).

name: view_fit_all
description: Zoom and pan so that everything fits in the 3D view.

name: view_fit_selection
description: Frame the current selection in the 3D view.

name: view_get_camera
description: Get the active camera as a string (Inventor format).

name: view_redraw
description: Force the 3D view to redraw immediately.

name: view_screenshot
description: Render the active 3D view to an image. Returns the image as base64 and, if path is given, also writes it to disk. Format: PNG by default.

path.description: Optional file path to write to

name: view_set_camera
description: Set the active camera from an Inventor-format string (as returned by view_get_camera).

name: view_set_orientation
description: Set the 3D view to a named orientation.

name: workbench_activate
description: Switch to a named workbench (e.g. 'PartDesignWorkbench', 'SketcherWorkbench').

name: workbench_active
description: Return the name of the currently active workbench.

name: workbench_list
description: List all available workbenches by internal name.
